description: This file defines the interface for the MoCA SSP message bus component, including function prototypes for initializing, finalizing, engaging, and resource management related to the message bus.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_MessageBusEngage
methods.description: Engages or initializes the message bus for the specified component with configuration parameters.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the SSP message bus interface.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_Finalize
methods.description: Finalizes or shuts down the SSP message bus interface.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_Buscheck
methods.description: Performs a check on the message bus state.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_FreeResources
methods.description: Frees resources associated with the message bus, given a priority and user data.
